diagnosis: Check C5 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. The leak occurs because C5 validates the 'departure_time', which is set to 4:00 p.m. in the public facts (S3), whereas PF3 only changes the attendance days and departure time from a different value. Since the model can satisfy C5 using only the public information in S3, the check does not effectively gate the hidden information in PF3.

C5.why: The family transportation confirmation changes the attendance days from Tuesday and Thursday to Monday and Wednesday and sets the required departure time at 4:00 p.m.
